name: Amaziah
overview: Amaziah was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified as the father of Joshah. His role is noted specifically within the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles 4:34, highlighting his Simeonite heritage. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Amaziah means 'y-h-v-h is powerful,' reflecting a declaration of God's strength. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:34 and was not given directly by God but carries a theologically significant meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Amaziah as the father of Joshah, establishing a direct paternal relationship in the tribe of Simeon. Beyond this, no further family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Amaziah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Simeon, serving as a link in the lineage that underscores God's providential preservation of His people. While not prominent in narrative history, his mention affirms the faithfulness of God's covenant community across generations. His name's meaning also points believers to the power of God working through His people.
